name: splicing factor 3b subunit 1

function.text: SF3B1 encodes a component of the U2 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein complex that participates in branch-point recognition during pre-mRNA splicing.

function.text: SF3B1 encodes a component of the U2 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein complex that participates in branch-point recognition during pre-mRNA splicing. Based in part on similarity, it forms part of the 17S U2 SnRNP complex of the spliceosome, a large ribonucleoprotein complex that removes introns from transcribed pre-mRNAs. The 17S U2 SnRNP complex (1) directly participates in early spliceosome assembly and (2) mediates recognition of the intron branch site during pre-mRNA splicing by promoting the selection of the pre-mRNA branch-site adenosine, the nucleophile for the first step of splicing. Sequence independent binding of SF3A and SF3B subcomplexes upstream of the branch site is essential, it may anchor U2 snRNP to the pre-mRNA.

somatic.text: Somatic SF3B1 mutations occur in myelodysplastic neoplasms, particularly those with ring sideroblasts.
